name: lookup_order
description: Look up a customer's order. Call this once you have an order number. Returns order status, tracking, items and totals, plus control flags the prompt branches on (need_order_number, order_not_found, verification_required, verification_failed, should_escalate, wrap_up). Never invent order details — only read back fields this returns.

called_number.description: Phone calls only. Empty string on the web widget.

client_ref.description: Web widget only. Empty string on phone calls.

conversation_id.description: Used as the call reference on the web, where there is no Twilio SID.

order_number.description: The order number the caller gave, digits only if possible. A leading # is fine — the server strips it.

verify_email.description: WEB ONLY. The email address the caller says is on the order. Required before any order details are returned on the web widget. Leave empty on phone calls.

verify_zip.description: WEB ONLY. The shipping ZIP code the caller gives, as an alternative to verify_email. Leave empty on phone calls.

_notes: ElevenLabs sends EVERY parameter on EVERY call, filling unused ones with empty strings. The function treats '' as absent — send both called_number and client_ref and let it decide.
On the web path the function returns verification_required and NO order fields until verify_email or verify_zip matches the order.
